description: A single distillery's monthly online whisky-auction price/volume history: per-month max/min/mean winning bid, total trading volume, and lots count. Prices are in the auctions' reporting currency and aggregate many online auction houses. Pass a distillery slug from list_distilleries (e.g. "macallan", "8_doors"). Returns the most recent ~60 months. Keyless.
name: distillery_prices
title: Distillery Prices
